text.text_excerpt: Came here spontaneously with some friends to grab dinner, as it was one of the few places nearby that was still open. We came around 10 pm on a Tuesday night and it was crowded. It's a small place with some patio seating, and since it was 40 degrees outside, we were lucky that they had one empty table inside for us. They have a pretty extensive menu, but none of that mattered upon realizing that it was a Tuesday and they have $1 Taco Tuesdays. How amazing is that?! I got 3 tacos: al pastor, carnitas, and brisket. They're street tacos - double tortilla with cilantro and chopped onions on top, and lime wedges on the side. 100% unbeatable for the price. The key to this place is going at the right time I guess. I've been here numerous times before and had 3 to 4 star experiences. This time I went early in the day on a Sunday with my son and we really had a great time. The chips were super fresh and went great with with the queso which is my fav. I think we really enjoyed the chips and queso more than the tacos but the tacos were bomb as well. The salsa is also very good. The place wasn't super crowded which was nice for a change. We got to pick a cool table by the windows and really just enjoyed the music (the cool music is another reason why I like this place) and tacos. I have been having trouble finding authentic Mexican food in New Orleans, as you can read in my previous reviews. Search no more, baby!!! I found some great tacos, at a great price ( $1. during M-F happy hour 3p-6p and $2 fish tacos). I forgot to see what the regular price was. I live close by, but have been reluctant to try here because it just seems like a touristy restaurant, from the outside patio to the name. I usually see twenty-some things outside in the evening. Nothing really wrong with that, but just not my thing (drunks and noisewise). There are good drink specials during the happy hour, too.
